how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-darnassus-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:2518:details:0: ⟦E9⟧ was once beloved of ⟦E11⟧. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.

rows.quest:730:obj:0: ⟦E14⟧ to Auberdine and look for signs of the dwarven excavation team.

rows.quest:952:obj:0: Deliver Fandral's message to ⟦E18⟧ in the ⟦E19⟧ in ⟦E6⟧, south of Auberdine.

rows.quest:3803:title: ⟦E21⟧ to ⟦E7⟧

rows.quest:3803:completion:0: Excellent - this morrowgrain will no doubt please the Arch ⟦E20⟧.  I must admit though... just being near them makes me feel a little uncomfortable.  I can only imagine how difficult it is for the Arch ⟦E20⟧ to tolerate them in such large numbers!⟦10⟧⟦11⟧This is for you, ⟦12⟧.  The Cenarion Circle thanks you for your continued support.
rows.quest:3763:details:0: Excuse me ⟦13⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:3763:details:1: The Cenarion Circle in ⟦E7⟧ is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than ⟦E23⟧ is spearheading this research.

rows.quest:3763:completion:1: Now that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
rows.quest:3764:obj:0: Bring 20 ⟦E24⟧ samples to ⟦E25⟧ at the Cenarion Enclave in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3764:details:0: The soil of ⟦E26⟧ is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities. I want to know facts from falsehoods; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough quality samples of soil for our continued study.

Bring the samples to ⟦E25⟧, who is no doubt wasting time outside behind this tree; just look for the piles of dirt. He will handle the logistics - not I.
rows.quest:3764:progress:0: Ah yes, the dirt. The Arch ⟦E20⟧ wants twenty loads per adventurer, and twenty loads he shall get. Let those who conspire against us fall to the wayside!

rows.quest:3764:completion:1: Arch ⟦E20⟧ Staghelm wants to speak with you again ⟦16⟧, but for his next task you will be aided if you have a journeyman's understanding of ⟦E27⟧. If you don't know it though, you will still be able to aid the Circle!
rows.quest:3781:obj:0: Take the Arch ⟦E20⟧'s ⟦E28⟧ to ⟦E29⟧ in the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3781:details:0: With what we call an ⟦E30⟧, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from ⟦E26⟧. These seeds blossom into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I intend to unravel this mystery.

rows.quest:3781:progress:0: Peace and serenity be yours, friend. You are here on business from the Arch ⟦E20⟧ himself, yes?
rows.quest:3781:completion:0: Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.
rows.quest:3781:completion:1: Those who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch ⟦E20⟧ offers far makes up for the cost.
rows.quest:3785:obj:0: Use an ⟦E30⟧ with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two ⟦E24⟧ samples to try and cultivate samples of ⟦E21⟧.

rows.quest:4493:details:0: It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology. Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on ⟦E16⟧.

As for Gracina's idea that ⟦E26⟧ is their heart... perhaps it is. Un'Goro is a mysterious and dangerous jungle to the west of here.
